query: Читай из таблицы public.transactions записи со статусом PENDING, конвертируй в JSON, публикуй в Kafka-топик transactions.overdue.

runs.yaml_pim:
flow:
  id: transactions_overdue_pipeline
  name: Publish Pending Transactions to Kafka
  description: Read pending transactions from public.transactions, convert to JSON,
    and publish to Kafka topic transactions.overdue
triggers:
- id: trigger_schedule
  type: schedule
  condition: '{{SCHEDULE_CONDITION}}'
sources:
- id: source_db
  name: Read Pending Transactions
  type: PostgreSQL
  location: public.transactions
  connection:
    properties:
      host: '{{DB_HOST}}'
      port: '{{DB_PORT}}'
      database: '{{DATABASE_NAME}}'
      username: '{{DB_USERNAME}}'
      password: '{{DB_PASSWORD}}'
      query: SELECT * FROM public.transactions WHERE status = 'PENDING'
processing_elements:
- id: process_convert
  name: Convert to JSON
  operation: Convert
  config:
    format: json
sinks:
- id: sink_kafka
  name: Publish to Kafka
  type: Kafka
  location: transactions.overdue
  connection:
    properties:
      brokers: '{{KAFKA_BROKERS}}'
      topic: transactions.overdue
processed_data:
- id: transactions_json
  format: json
links:
- from_id: source_db
  to_id: process_convert
  data_ref: transactions_json
- from_id: process_convert
  to_id: sink_kafka
  data_ref: transactions_json
